name: Brindle Hearth
tone: Warm and unhurried, like a long supper beside an open fire.
headline: Fire, salt and a long table
subline: Wood-fired plates from a Leeds kitchen that cooks only what the market sends that morning.

name: Oddlot Atelier
tone: Cheeky and loud, with a grin about taking clothes seriously.
headline: Clothes that talk over dinner
subline: Bold jackets and trousers cut from reclaimed fabric in small runs in Glasgow.

name: Lintel & Grain Architects
tone: Calm, measured and precise, letting the materials speak.
headline: Quiet buildings, built to last
subline: A Bristol practice designing homes and schools in timber, brick and lime.

name: Driftquery
tone: Dry, technical and direct, written by engineers for engineers.
headline: Find the slow query before users do
subline: Driftquery watches your database and flags the queries that cost you time, with plain explanations.

name: Marrow Lane Savings
tone: Trustworthy and plainspoken, with no jargon and no surprises.
headline: Savings that stay simple
subline: A member-owned savings society in Cardiff with one account, clear rates and no small print.

name: Wren Street Museum of Everyday Objects
tone: Curious and gently witty, treating the ordinary as worth a second look.
headline: Look again at the ordinary
subline: A museum of kettles, keys and kitchen drawers, with stories from the people who used them.

name: Low Tide Records
tone: Moody, underground and a little secretive.
headline: Records made after midnight
subline: An independent Manchester label pressing limited vinyl from bands you have not heard yet.

name: Northfield Fell Runners
tone: Encouraging and outdoorsy, with muddy boots and no ego.
headline: Run the hills, finish together
subline: A Lake District running club for all paces, with weekly group runs and navigation coaching.

name: Fennel Physio
tone: Reassuring and practical, speaking to patients as capable adults.
headline: Move without the worry
subline: Physiotherapy in Norwich built around your goals, with clear plans and no long waits.

name: Kittiwake Rail Holidays
tone: Nostalgic and relaxed, in favour of the journey over the destination.
headline: Cross Europe by sleeper train
subline: Small-group rail holidays with pre-booked berths, local guides and time to look out of the window.

name: Marginalia Press
tone: Scholarly and austere, with quiet pride in the printed page.
headline: Books for slow readers
subline: An independent Edinburgh press publishing translated fiction and neglected essays.

name: Bramble Dice Games
tone: Boisterous and playful, built for noisy family evenings.
headline: Games for loud tables
subline: Card and board games from a Sheffield studio, made for families who cannot agree on the rules.
